channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Atlassian
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Atlassian, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch: Atlassian (multiple products): Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties
item.description:
Atlassian (multiple products): Arbitrary file read · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 10.2.24, 12.1.12, 10.2.8

First step: Update the affected Atlassian products to the fixed version for your release line (for example 10.2.24, 12.1.12 or 10.2.8).

Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-21589
